model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for six different language models – mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2 – across seven language families. The horizontal axis represents the language family, labeled as “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “IE-other”, “Isolate”, “Semitic”, and “Uralic”, displayed in this specific order. The vertical axis, labeled “effect”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5. For each language family, there are six bars representing each of the models, colored in green, light blue, red, pink, dark green, and light red respectively; each bar also includes error bars extending above and below. The shortest bars are those for “Isolate”, with mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2 near a value of 1, and the tallest bars are seen for “IE-Baltic”, where mBERT-L2 reaches approximately 31, and XLM-L2 reaches approximately 29. The bars are grouped by language family, with each model represented as a single bar within that group, and are not sorted by value within the language family. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
